versions.changelog:
table-specification-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release: provides an end-to-end workflow for compiling exam specification tables (双向细目表) for vocational education exams.
- Supports three course types with tailored competency taxonomies: cognitive (Bloom), psychomotor (Simpson), affective (Krathwohl).
- Strictly requires and structures exam blueprint based on provided syllabus, enforcing full coverage, accurate difficulty balance, and detailed test item targeting.
- Includes automatic course type recognition, step-by-step extraction and user confirmation of key syllabus elements, and mandates the inclusion of context-rich, real-world application scenarios.
- Mandates quality control: total points, topic coverage, and difficulty distributions must match syllabus requirements, with all deviations explained.
- Outputs include structured markdown tables, subjective item scoring guides, and transparent rationale for all design decisions.
